name: Fix your social anxiety simulator
source:
Just a silly little game where you have anxiety and you wanna get rid of it!! Where nothing irregular happens at all <3

While on the way home from attending a course on 'fixing your life' you notice three very normal  guys sitting on the bus with you.

You can pick one of three totally normal guys to test out the advice you were given.

[From [url=https://parasiteworks.itch.io/fix-your-social-anxiety-simulator]itch.io[/url]]
